verdict.rationale: Box documents a public REST API at https://api.box.com/2.0 with OAuth 2.0, a quickstart curl call, and guides covering uploads, search, metadata, collaborations, webhooks, events, Box AI and Sign. Together these let an AI-native user drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: API requests use the base URL `https://api.box.com/2.0` and require an OAuth 2.0 access token
Replace <ACCESS_TOKEN> with a developer token and run: curl https://api.box.com/2.0/users/me
Sign up for a Box free developer account, generate the developer token and make your first API call.
The Box API provides a way to find content in Box using full-text search queries.
Use the Box AI API to ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize files stored in Box.
